description: Diagram 2.31, titled "Wall type 3 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf", is a drawing labelled "PLAN" in its lower right corner. It shows a plan view of a wall junction forming a T shape. Across the top runs a horizontal band of masonry blocks, drawn as a row of hatched rectangles separated by vertical lines. Below this, a second horizontal band of masonry blocks runs along the left and right; from the centre, between them, a vertical element filled with a diagonal cross‑hatch pattern and divided by horizontal lines into stacked segments extends downwards. Beneath the left and right masonry there is a thin gap representing the cavity, and below the gap each side carries an L‑shaped assembly of thin parallel lines: a horizontal part running outwards, joined at its inner end to a vertical part that runs downwards. On the right‑hand vertical part two small squares marked with an X are visible, one near the top and one further down. The label "Cavity stop" has an arrow pointing rightwards into the cross‑hatched block at the top junction. The label "Independent panels" appears on both the left and the right, each with two arrows, one pointing upwards to a horizontal line and one diagonally to the parallel vertical lines of the panel.

Diagram 2.31, titled "Wall type 3 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf", is a drawing labelled "PLAN" in its lower right corner. It shows a plan view of a wall junction forming an L or T shape. Across the top runs a horizontal band of masonry blocks, drawn as a row of hatched rectangles separated by vertical lines. From the centre of this band a vertical element, filled with a diagonal cross‑hatch pattern and divided by horizontal lines into stacked segments, extends downwards.

Two horizontal wall leaves project left and right from the upper band, each drawn as a hatched strip with a thin gap beneath it representing the cavity. At the outer end of each leaf sits a thin assembly of parallel vertical lines; on the right‑hand assembly two small squares marked with an X are visible near the top.

The label "Cavity stop" has an arrow pointing rightwards into the cross‑hatched block at the top junction. The label "Independent panels" appears on both the left and the right, each with two arrows, one pointing upwards to a horizontal line and one diagonally to the parallel vertical lines of the panel.
